title: 3 birds you can see in India, in 12 seconds

scenes.headline: 3 birds you can see in India
Rattles his train about 25 times a second
Watches from a perch, then dives for small fish

caption:
Three birds, three ways to make a living.

Hornbills nest walled into tree holes: the male seals the entrance with mud and passes food through a gap.

Source: PLOS ONE (Dakin et al. 2016); Animal Diversity Web; Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Compilation demo: one fact per clip, all CC media (Hyderabad garden peacock, wild kingfisher, wild hornbill). Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here.
